answer: The quill cap is upheld at intake and vault shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a fleet in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, as each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a tundra tag. Bonded capital sits idle for 15 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
